key_insight: Nano- and micro-textures in perovskite solar cells do more than reduce reflection: they also improve wetting, crystal quality, carrier extraction, and mechanical robustness.
engineering_relevance: Texture engineering is a multi-function design lever that can raise efficiency and reliability in perovskite photovoltaics and related optoelectronic devices.
method: Review of recently reported texture-related effects in perovskite-based devices
Comparison of nano- and micro-texture benefits beyond light trapping
Synthesis of impacts on wetting, crystallinity, extraction, and flexibility
evidence_signal: The paper is a literature review summarizing recently reported experimental findings, not a new dataset or single-device benchmark.
watch_item: Texture benefits may depend strongly on fabrication process, material stack, and surface geometry, so gains may not transfer directly across device architectures.
paper_title: More than just light management -- The multiple advantages of nano- and micro-textures in perovskite solar cells
